title: Calendar
description: Calendar app (📅) of the person: Google Calendar is only the transport, a copy lives on the home server (one store per person, read-only sync), the page reaches it through the module home-relay (the site carries only end-to-end encrypted requests and answers). Week, day and agenda views, conflicts, a tray with the next meeting. Read only in 0.1: decisions and the agent come in 0.2 (docs/SPEC-calendar.md).

data.home: on the home server /srv/data/calendar/<slug>/calendar.db per person (copy of the provider + own layer), /etc/calendar/<slug>.env
data.server: none of its own: sealed items pass through the module home-relay
